name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 5 visits over 29 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 20 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 28 hours starting 2026-03-28, at wavelengths from 1.38 to 4.96 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
